---
title: AI Live Assistant
---

Start and stop real-time bidirectional multimodal audio and camera sessions with Gemini Live. A spatial `UICard` displays live connection status and real-time conversation transcripts.

> [!NOTE]
> For local prototyping, the pre-launch dialog accepts a Gemini API key stored locally in your browser. Production applications must proxy AI requests through a secure server.

### Desktop Controls (User Mode)

- **Toggle Assistant:** Left-click the **Start** / **Stop** button to connect or disconnect the live session.
- **Move / Resize Card:** Left-click and drag the card border to reposition, or scroll with the mouse wheel to scale.
- **Rotate:** Right-click and drag the mouse to look around.

### XR Controls

- **Toggle Assistant:** Ray-pinch or tap the **Start** / **Stop** button.
- **Reposition Card:** Pinch the card border and drag to place it anywhere in your environment.
